Proposes an overwritePropagationPass() in sync-workspace-step4c.js mirroring PROP-091's Phase 0/1/2 shape and PROP-051 safety gates. Two-guard candidate rule (content-hash diff AND git-last-commit-time > lastSentinelAt), explicit 12-entry allow-list of latest-*-summary.txt surfaces, config-gated enabled=false (manifest-only), EPERM->manifest-only fallback. Answers directive Q1 (content-hash, not FUSE-mtime per PROP-082), Q2 (explicit allow-list — OWNERSHIP-derivation rejected because it would miss the append_only_glob frozen case, the directive's own headline example latest-tinker-summary.txt), Q3 (canonical = latest-in-git; OWNERSHIP unchanged; direction guard protects local unpushed writes), Q4 (sibling PROP, not folded into PROP-091, ranked by ship-safety). Propose-only — no script/config edited this run. Embedded code passes node --check.

findings.title: The overwrite-mode gap is broader than the directive's framing and spans BOTH OWNERSHIP categories
findings.detail: Directive framed the gap as 'smart_copy mtime guard skips existing files'. The actual mechanism in build.js syncToWorkspace (what dome-mirror invokes) is two distinct create-only behaviors: (a) category==='workspace' files (latest-decider/baby/score/rewrite-summary.txt) are skipped WHOLESALE — never copied git->FUSE at all; (b) append_only/append_only_glob .txt files are either filtered out (walkAppendOnly copies '.json' only) or copied ONCE then frozen ('if (fs.existsSync(dst)) continue'). The directive's headline example (latest-tinker-summary.txt) is sub-case (b)-frozen, NOT a 'workspace' file. All 12 latest-*-summary.txt surfaces are affected. PROP-092's allow-list covers both sub-cases; an OWNERSHIP-derived list would have missed (b).
findings.evidence: build.js syncToWorkspace lines ~401-446 (copyIfExists unconditional for 'git'; 'skip (workspace-owned)' branch; walkAppendOnly 'if exists continue' + '.json'-only globExt).
